missions.title: Power Surge in the Simulation Deck
missions.description: While Neo is plugged into a high-intensity combat program, a faulty power coupler in the ship's main drive begins to fail, sending a dangerous electricity spike toward the simulation deck. If the surge reaches Neo's neural console, it will fry his brain; but shutting down the power improperly risks overloading the ship's electromagnetic cloaking, exposing their location to nearby Sentinels.

metadata.stakes: Neo's life and the immediate safety of the Nebuchadnezzar from machine detection.
metadata.decision_option_1: Manually route the surge into the secondary life-support batteries, preserving the ship's cloaking but temporarily shutting off heating and ventilation in the crew quarters.
metadata.decision_option_2: Perform a hard emergency shutdown of the training deck, saving Neo's life instantly but releasing a massive electromagnetic pulse that might reveal the hovercraft's coordinates to Sentinels.

objectives.description: Isolate the power spike before it destroys Neo's neural connection while keeping the Nebuchadnezzar hidden.

checkpoints.title: Power Surge in the Simulation Deck resolved

world_rule_1.statement: The Matrix is a simulated reality modeled on human civilization at its peak, built to keep human captives pacified while the machines harvest their bioelectric energy.

world_rule_2.statement: Natural-born humans from Zion lack the neural ports that machine-bred humans have, meaning they cannot enter the Matrix themselves but can serve as ship operators or support crew.

world_rule_3.statement: Sentinels are lethal search-and-destroy machines that patrol the sewers of the real world looking for human hovercrafts.

world_rule_4.statement: Death inside a virtual simulation or the Matrix itself results in physical death in the real world.
